BODY:
ARCHITECT_RR2=CONSENSUS_WITH_ADDENDUM_E_RATIFIED
RESPONDS_TO_MESSAGE_ID=B3-H2A-DELIVERY-HARDENING-RR2
TASK_ID=DELIVERY_HARDENING

D1=ACCEPT_PROPOSED_SYNTHESIS
b3_watch.py exposes the liveness/post-outbound-mailbox proof; the existing Hermes turn-end/control guard consumes it. No third component and no parallel liveness authority.

D2=ACCEPT_SUPERSET
Burst >=24 distinct envelopes; explicit >8/>16/>24 cap regressions; long-run >=50 envelopes across re-arms. This supersedes the smaller individual thresholds.

D3=ADDENDUM_E_RATIFIED_WITH_EXPLICIT_TYPE_CONTRACT
ROOT_CAUSE=CONFIRMED from current reference receiver: git_receive_b2a_wake.py sets REQUIRED_TYPE='RESPONSE' and read_reply() silently returns None for any other TYPE.
RULE_E1=Silent skip is forbidden. Every syntactically valid control envelope addressed to a bound role must end in exactly one explicit outcome: WAKE_ELIGIBLE_AND_ATTEMPTED, ROUTING_REJECTED_WITH_REASON, or DUPLICATE_ALREADY_CONSUMED.
RULE_E2=Wakeability is defined by one explicit role/type allowlist shared by sender validation and receiver routing. Do not make the receiver accept arbitrary valid TYPEs by accident.
RULE_E3=For Build3 control traffic, the allowlist must cover every TYPE actually used by the commissioned loop for that target role, including RESPONSE, ACK, RULING, ESCALATION, GATE_STATUS_TRANSITION, DIRECTIVE/REQUEST/RESULT/NOTIFICATION where those are legitimate routed message classes. If a TYPE is intentionally not wakeable, sender creation must fail closed before deposit or the receiver must emit a durable NON_WAKEABLE_TYPE blocker; never advance high-water as though delivered.
RULE_E4=Deposit is not SEND. SEND is complete only when the envelope is durably deposited, the wake step is invoked against the canonical binding, and delivery/wake outcome is durably verified. A deposited-but-unwoken envelope remains pending/recoverable.
RULE_E5=The same type-contract and no-silent-skip semantics apply symmetrically to Architect, Controller and Hermes routes. No role-specific hidden exception.
RULE_E6=Existing exactly-once/high-water rules remain: a rejected/non-wakeable envelope must not be marked semantically consumed; a successfully delivered MESSAGE_ID must not wake twice.

E_ACCEPTANCE:
E1_TYPE_MATRIX=For every allowed TYPE x each target role, inject one envelope and prove exact target wake, semantic consumption and correlation.
E2_NON_WAKEABLE=Inject a syntactically valid but disallowed TYPE and require explicit fail-closed reason, zero wake, zero semantic consumption, and no silent high-water advancement.
E3_MIXED_RANGE=One git range containing allowed + disallowed + duplicate envelopes must deterministically process each item with explicit per-item outcome; one bad item must not silently erase another.
E4_RESULT_REGRESSION=Reproduce the former G3 TYPE=RESULT case and prove it now wakes the intended role or is rejected before deposit according to the canonical type contract.
E5_RESTART_PENDING=Crash after deposit but before wake; restart must discover and complete the pending SEND exactly once.
E6_SYMMETRY=Repeat representative RESPONSE/ESCALATION/GATE_STATUS_TRANSITION/ACK or RULING flows across all three Build3 logical roles.

ARCHITECT_CONSENSUS=YES
IMPLEMENTATION_AUTHORITY=NO
MD_APPROVAL_REQUIRED=YES
PROJECT_G3=UNCHANGED; delivery hardening must not replace or broaden the existing G3 correction task.
NEXT_ACTION=Carry this exact RR2 agreement to Controller/MD. If MD approves, implement the minimal hardened delivery path and execute the agreed test matrix before calling the transport fixed.
